headline: Uncle Sam 💥🦅 GONNA SQUASH 🥪 Iran Regime Like A Bug 🐜💀
text: Treasury Daddy Scott Bessent 💼🤑 just went FULL THROTTLE 🚀⚡ on Iran saying 'YO ALLIES 🌍 either WITH US 🇺🇸 or AGAINST US 🖕' and promised to COLLAPSE 🏚️💥 the regime like a cheap tent! He claims these sanctions will SQUASH 🥪 the Iranian economy harder than a bug under Trump's boot 🥾🍊 and maybe even AVOID going back to WAR 💣🔥 with them! Trump 🍊👑 warned anyone throwing LIFELINES 🏊‍♂️ to Tehran will face 'TREMENDOUS ECONOMIC CONSEQUENCES' 💸😱 like getting the ULTIMATE financial TIMEOUT ⏰❌! Bessent teased the 'GREATEST COORDINATED ECONOMIC ISOLATION IN HISTORY' 🌍🚫 will hit harder than Operation Economic Fury 💼⚔️ which already BLOCKADED 🚢🚫 Iranian ports and went after foreign banks doing business with the regime! Iran shut the Strait of Hormuz 🌊🚫 causing 20% of world oil to go BRRRRR 📈💸 and now Trump wants to drop the 'MOST CRUSHING ECONOMIC OPERATION EVER' 💥🗡️ on them! Meanwhile Iranian folks are PROTESTING 🪧😡 over 60% inflation and DOUBLED food prices 🍞📈 blaming the regime for their pain! Trump told them 'HELP IS ON THE WAY' 🆘 but locals say they've been LIVING UNDER SANCTIONS since 1979 and know how to ROLL WITH THE PUNCHES 🥊💪! Bessent drops the tea ☕ on August 24th with more DEETS 📜🔥 but one thing's clear - it's either TEAM AMERICA 🇺🇸 or get the SANCTION HAMMER 🔨💸 dropped on you too!
